exposure: spontaneous normal labour delivered vaginally at term
elective caesarean section at term without labour
preterm with premature rupture of membranes
Elective caesarean section at term without labour (TNL)
outcome: Leukocyte migration towards a chemotactic signal
cohort: Pregnant women in various stages of late gestation
finding: Leukocytes from women in labour or soon to go into labour showed increased migration towards a chemotactic signal compared to those not in labour.
mod_finding: The study found that leukocytes from women in labor, both term and preterm, migrated more towards a chemotactic signal compared to those not in labor, suggesting a potential predictive marker for delivery.
